title.en: An Act Naming the Mountain Province Police Provincial Office in the Capital Town of Bontoc, Mountain Province to Camp Lt. Geronimo F. Montes

text.en: The Mountain Province Police Provincial Office in the Capital Town of Bontoc, Mountain Province is hereby named Camp Lt. Geronimo F. Montes.
The Philippine National Police (PNP) shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
